_doc: Combined correctness roll (tools/check_roll.py, docs/TOOLKIT.md 1.8c). Each lane adds its own entries: the gates that switch its CHECK / census / meter on, a regex that must match at least once (pass), and a regex that must never match (fail). Entries whose gates do not exist on the exe under test are harmless (unknown SR_* variables are ignored) but will fail their pass regex, so keep enabled=false until the code is on dev. Perf A/Bs never go here: the checks slow the game.

draw builder S0 census (cut draws seen, redundancy line)
stream-resident constant dedup CHECK (0 BAD)
checks._note: SR_NATIVE_CONST_DEDUP_CHECK=1 turns the (default ON) skips off by itself and flags each predicted group for the CP: in the S1 records (tag bit 30) and in the PM4 leaf (DDCK)

SR_NB_AOT: strand B's compute kernels load from data/shader_cache/nb - nothing compiles at run time (EDRAM zero step 1)

checks.name: EDRAM zero step 3: the surface table decides, the tile map checks every claim and owner query (SR_NB_SURF_VERIFY)
VdGetSystemCommandBuffer = Xenia's fill: Swap's descriptor +0 BEEF0000, +4 / +8 zero, r7 BEEF0001 (SR_VD_SYSCMDBUF, baked default ON)
scan-out registers V_COUNTER / VIEWPORT_SIZE as Xenia (SR_VD_SCANOUT_REGS, baked default ON)
ring from the VdInitializeRingBuffer argument, no pre-claim heap route (SR_VD_RING_ARG, baked default ON; audit U1)
the live backend is attached before the CP's first command (no boot backlog: the black-world race)
checks.pass: \[DISPLAY\] PM4 live backend attached: guest VdSwaps before it 0, draw commands queued 0\b
checks.fail: \[DISPLAY\] PM4 live backend attached: guest VdSwaps before it [1-9]|\[DISPLAY\] CP waited .*(TIMED OUT|INIT FAILED)
checks._note: iter-467 native-b job65: with the CP running before main() attached the D3D12 backend (=SR_PM4_WAIT_BACKEND=0), the boot frames' draw queue saturated (8,191 queued after 55 guest swaps) in 2 of 3 rolls and those two drew the 3D world black (eye-adaptation history NaN, ENGINE_MAP 6g.8d); SR_PM4_WAIT_BACKEND (default ON) waits at cpMain. render/boot-attach: the pass pattern held a JSON backspace ("\b" instead of "\\b") and could never match - fixed; the CP's wait for the attach has no time limit (a Warn every 10 s, the total wait logged); an explicit D3D12 init failure logs INIT FAILED and exits 3 (FATAL). TIMED OUT stays in the fail pattern for logs of the earlier 60 s limit.

checks.name: boot attach: the shader cache loads off the attach path and the CP starts with the installed cache loaded (render/boot-attach, SR_SHADER_LOAD_ASYNC, WP1)
checks.pass: \[SHADER_CACHE\] CP start: waited [0-9.]+ ms for the installed shader cache \(loaded;
checks.fail: \[SHADER_CACHE\] CP start: .*\(none installed;|\[SHADER_CACHE\] boot load: the installed stage failed|\[FATAL\] the live D3D12 backend
checks._note: docs/NATIVE_ROADMAP.md 'Boot attach': D3D12Backend::init starts the load on its own thread (probe first), main() attaches at once, the CP waits for the installed stage before its first command (WP1) and every cache lookup waits for the stage its answer needs (WP2). The wait itself is the live measurement (the pack-file decision): '[SHADER_CACHE] CP start: waited N ms'.

checks.name: stage 3: native resolves vs the EDRAM word model, the mixed-owner spans included (SR_NATIVE_RESOLVE_VERIFY, dev log profile)

checks.pass: \[NATIVE_RESOLVE\] span of key [0-9A-F]{8} owned by [0-9A-F]{8} \+ [0-9A-F]{8} .*: native, owner per tile

checks.name: stage 3: the surface table (shipping) agrees with the tile map (oracle) on every claim and owner query
stage 3: census path letters - M present, no E / C (no resolve through the word model)
stage 3: the native kernel declined nothing it was asked for; no kernel compiled at run time (the shipped blobs served every resolve)
stage 3: edram_res / edram_xfer / edram_load 0 for the whole run (edram_xfer = moves executed through the word model)
stage 3: the roll completes (terminal snapshot), no crash / hang / stall
